prompt: Inside a two-storey British shopping centre, every shop unit dark behind its grille: the atrium floor and both galleries are packed with tents, laundry hung from the balconies, people sitting on the dead escalators, grey daylight from the glass roof. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
